verdict.rationale: Evidence shows PayPal and Braintree gateway support plus multi-currency/localized pricing with supported payment gateways, indicating some third-party gateway choice and multi-currency charging exist. However, there's no documentation of a broad marketplace of alternative gateways beyond these two examples, nor detail on how merchants configure/select gateways. Missing for 10: a documented list/marketplace of supported third-party gateways, explicit merchant-facing gateway selection UI/workflow, and independent confirmation of multi-currency charging in practice.
